Find [[Footman Tate]] and [[Footman Quinn]], who have been accused of stealing in the temple, and bring them to justice.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Search the [[Eastern Frontier]] and [[Pockmark Flats]] for [[Footman Tate]] and [[Footman Quinn]].  Bring them to justice.
* Footman Tate surrendered.  Lead him back to the [[Frontier Gate]].
* Kill Footman Quinn.
* Return to Warmaster Riga for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 200 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Longbow]] of [[Fortitude]]
** [[Piercing Dmg]]: 11-18 (Requires 3 [[Marksmanship]])
** Damage +10% (while in a stance)
** Health +20
** Two-handed
* [[Jeweled Chakram]]
** [[Energy]] +6 (Requires 5 [[Inspiration Magic]])
** Halves Skill Recharge of Spells (10% chance)
** Energy +5 (while enchanted)

{{anomaly|The Jeweled Chakram has what would normally be the skin and attribute of a [[Jeweled Chalice]]. Conversely, the quest [[A Mission of Peace]] rewards a Jeweled Chalice with the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chakram.}}

==Walkthrough==
===Footman Tate===
To get to Footman Tate, travel southeast from the Frontier Gate.  You'll encounter some [[Devourer]]s along the way as they pop out of the ground, but if you take them a group at a time, you'll have no problems defeating them.  The path will curve around east and then veer northeast after the collector, then turn sharply back towards the south.  Keep following the path and hug the wall (being careful not to aggro the Devourers on top of the plateau).  Round the corner and head northeast in the chasm before tapering off east.  Round the corner south and climb the small knoll.  A group of Devourers may be waiting for you, but they're not too tough.  Defeat them, and speak with Footman Tate (location marked by the green indicator on the first map).

If you choose the conversation choices "Don't make me kill you" or "If you run, I'll find you," he'll simply respond with "I don't know what to do.  This is all very confusing."  He'll agree to follow you if you tell him that "everything will be all right."  Simply reverse the path you took to get to him and escort him back to the Frontier Gate.

===Footman Quinn===
It's quicker to reach Footman Quinn by departing from [[Fort Ranik (outpost)|Fort Ranik]].  Travel south and walk under the aqueduct/series of arches.  You'll encounter some [[Renegade]]s and some Charr (depending on what quests you have active), but they're relatively easy to take care of.  Some Devourers may pop up from the ground, but defeat them and head east.  Walk through the zone to [[Pockmark Flats]].

Once you're in Pockmark Flats, head east and follow the path.  You'll encounter a [[Crimson Devourer]] or two along with some [[Flash Gargoyle|Flash]] and [[Shatter Gargoyle]]s and perhaps a [[Storm Rider]] or two.  Head north until you reach the aqueduct/series of arches and head east, following the structure.  You may have to fight some Wind Riders, [[Hulking Stone Elemental]]s, and a [[Stone Elemental]], but fight the Riders and the Elementals separately and you shouldn't have too much of a problem.  Stick with the path and follow it southeast.  You'll reach a point where you can take the first path north, but keep heading down until you reach the shoreline and follow that north.  You'll have to follow a winding path up northeast, but after you crest the hill, Footman Quinn will be waiting for you (the green indicator on the second map).
Alternatively, you can travel south from Serenity Temple through Pockmark Flats.

Once you kill him, map back to the Frontier Gate to get your reward from Warmaster Riga.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Warmaster Riga
:''"I was appalled when I heard what happened. It is unconscionable that two of my men would try to steal from the Temple, but when I went to confront '''Footman Tate''' and '''Footman Quinn''' with these allegations, I discovered they had fled.''

:''I do not think they can have gone far. Shiftless and gutless as they both are, they must be within the '''Eastern Frontier''' or perhaps as far south as '''Pockmark Flats'''. And yet, now, more than ever, all my men must stay focused on defending the Wall. Will you find these two and bring them to justice?"''
